cards.answer: Darius is a Fighter/Tank who pulls enemies close and builds up a physical-damage bleed. He gains attack damage through his passive and heals with outer-blade Q hits on champions and large monsters.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended close-range trades that let him build bleed stacks.

cards.answer: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times. Reaching five stacks on an enemy champion or killing a champion with R temporarily grants Noxian Might. This grants attack damage and makes eligible bleed applications apply maximum stacks.
cards.counterplay: Disengage before he builds maximum stacks on you. Avoid letting an empowered Darius spread maximum stacks to more champions.

citations.quote: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
Hemorrhage: Deal physical damage to the target over a few seconds. For each stack, this damage is increased.

facts.claim: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times.

citations.quote: When Darius kills a champion with Noxian Guillotine, or applies 5 stacks on an enemy champion, he becomes empowered with Noxian Might for 5 seconds.

facts.claim: Reaching five stacks on an enemy champion or killing a champion with R temporarily grants Noxian Might.

citations.quote: Noxian Might: Darius gains attack damage and always applies the maximum stacks of Hemorrhage.

facts.claim: This grants attack damage and makes eligible bleed applications apply maximum stacks.

cards.priority_reason: Maximum stacks empower Darius and let him spread his strongest bleed.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
No visual cue is proposed: text sources do not describe the visible markers or emblem, and demonstration frames do not establish current-client appearance.
Applications require damage and exclude structures, wards and invulnerable targets; Q handle hits do not apply or refresh Hemorrhage.
Ordinary shields permit bleed application and refresh; spell shields prevent application from abilities.
Clone and resurrection-protected R kills do not grant Noxian Might; zombie-state finishes can reset R without granting Noxian Might.

cards.answer: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage. The outer blade deals more damage and can apply Hemorrhage; the inner handle deals less damage and neither applies nor refreshes it. Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of eligible targets hit.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the swing or inside the blade's outer reach. Avoid grouping where the blade can hit several champions.

cards.answer: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target. Activating W after a basic attack lets him attack again sooner.
cards.counterplay: Keep outside the empowered attack's reach to avoid its damage and slow.

cards.answer: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage. When activated, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Stay outside the cone's reach or move sideways out of its path.

Passive: Darius gains armor penetration.

facts.claim: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage.

When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

facts.claim: When activated, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.

cards.priority_reason: The pull forces enemies into close combat, and the slow helps keep them nearby.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.

The supported airborne rebound is omitted from the beginner explanation; its slow begins when targets rebound.
The passive penetration benefits Darius's physical damage and does not reduce armor for allies.

cards.answer: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leap strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target. A qualifying kill lets him use R again through a temporary recast window; at maximum rank, it resets the cooldown permanently.
cards.counterplay: Avoid staying in his reach with low health and many bleed stacks. Spread out to limit his access to another target after a kill.

citations.quote: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target.
dealing true damage based on the target's current Hemorrhage stacks.

facts.claim: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leap strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target.

citations.quote: He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.
At max rank, Noxian Guillotine permanently resets its cooldown if the target dies very briefly afterwards.

facts.claim: A qualifying kill lets him use R again through a temporary recast window; at maximum rank, it resets the cooldown permanently.

cards.priority_reason: Stack-enhanced true damage and kill-based reuse threaten repeated finishes.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Qualification includes a brief post-hit death window; clone and resurrection-protected kills do not reset R.
Zombie-state finishes can reset R without granting Noxian Might.
Leap movement depends on distance and terrain and does not provide unrestricted terrain traversal.
R applies Hemorrhage after its damage. Roots and grounding prevent casting; losing a valid target during the cast can cancel it without spending its cost or starting its cooldown.
